description: A man with long wavy brown hair, seen in profile, sits at a wooden table in a dark room and writes with a quill on a folded sheet covered in small handwritten-looking lines. He wears a dark doublet with a broad white falling collar and cuffs. A lit candle, stacked leather-bound books, an ink pot, crumpled paper balls, two dice and a scatter of coins sit on the table, and a wooden chair edge is visible at left. The style is a dark, painterly chiaroscuro that runs to all four edges with no frame or wall.
